title: fix(app-shell): render action's objectName as an object selector (#2325)
body:
## Summary

When creating a new **Action** in the metadata admin, the object-binding field (`objectName`) rendered as a plain text input instead of an object-picker dropdown — so authors had to type the target object name by hand. This was inconsistent with `view` / `page`, whose object field is a proper `ref:object` dropdown.

Fixes #2325.

## Root cause

In `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts`, the `action` resource listed `objectName` in `createFields` but shipped **no `createSchema`**. In create mode `ResourceEditPage` uses `config.createSchema` when present, otherwise falls back to the server's edit schema / FormView — where `objectName` is just a `string` with no widget hint, so `SchemaForm` renders it as a text input. `view` / `page` avoid this by declaring their object field with `widget: 'ref:object'` in their own `createSchema`.

## Fix

Add a `createSchema` to the `action` registration (same pattern as `view` / `page`):

- `objectName` → `widget: 'ref:object'` (the searchable object dropdown fed by the prefetched object list).
- `icon` → `widget: 'icon'` (the Lucide picker).
- Required is only `['label', 'name']`; `objectName` stays **optional** because record-scoped / global actions bind no object.

`objectName` is the spec's `ActionSchema` → object binding key — I confirmed against `@objectstack/spec@14.6.0` that `ActionSchema` exposes `objectName` and has **no** `object` field. Adding the `createSchema` does not change the saved body (create output is built from `createFields` + `createDefaults`, not the schema), so create→save round-trips and spec conformance are unaffected.

## Testing

- `anchors.action-createschema.test.ts` — pins the create-form contract: `createSchema` present, every `createFields` key has a matching schema property, `objectName` widget is `ref:object`, `objectName` optional (label/name required), `icon` is the picker.
- `SchemaForm.actionObjectPicker.test.tsx` — renders the **actual registry `createSchema`** and asserts `objectName` mounts as the `ref:object` `<Select>` (`role="combobox"`) while `name` stays a text `<input>` — the exact before/after of the bug. This guard also fails if either the `createSchema` or the `widget` hint is later removed.
- Full `metadata-admin` suite green (591 tests), including `createConformance` (action create output still spec-valid).

## Note (out of scope)

While verifying, I noticed the same `action` entry's Related-tab anchor matches `['object', 'target.object', 'on.object']` but `ActionSchema` has no top-level `object` (it uses `objectName`). A standalone action bound only via top-level `objectName` therefore won't surface under an object's **Related → Actions**. Left untouched here to keep this PR scoped to #2325 — flagging for a maintainer.
